detailed_description: The Diff Checker compares two text blocks line by line. Paste the original text on the left, the modified text on the right, and run the comparison to see unchanged, added, and removed lines. It is useful for quick reviews of notes, snippets, configuration changes, or short copy edits. The current page performs a straightforward line comparison rather than a full version-control diff, so it is best for small to medium text checks where a fast visual summary is enough.
usage_steps: Paste the original text into the first text area.
Paste the changed text into the second text area.
Click Compare to generate the diff view.
Review the added, removed, and unchanged line counts.
Scan the highlighted output for the exact changed lines.
Use Clear when you want to reset both inputs.
usage_examples: Compare two versions of a release note before publishing.
Check which lines changed in a small config snippet.
Review copy edits from a teammate without opening a full Git tool.
Compare two pasted API responses at a quick line-by-line level.

faqs.question: What type of diff does this page show?
faqs.answer: It shows a simple line-by-line comparison with added, removed, and unchanged lines.

faqs.question: Is this the same as a Git diff?
faqs.answer: No. It is a lightweight browser comparison, not a full Git patch or merge tool.

faqs.question: Can I compare code snippets?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially short snippets or configuration blocks where line changes are easy to review.

faqs.question: Does it ignore whitespace automatically?
faqs.answer: No. The comparison uses the text as entered, so whitespace differences can appear as changes.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my text?
faqs.answer: The visible comparison runs in the browser page. Do not paste secrets or private data on shared devices.
